title: Translatable crowd speech
description: Makes crowd speech in warden boss fight translatable
body:
### This mod allows resourcepacks to translate crowd speech during warden boss fight (and mine item tooltip)
Because mojang made them literal(not translatable) text for some reason

<details>
<summary>List of translate keys</summary>
  
```
{
  "warden.boss.crowd0": "Why are they trying to start the show now? We will get quiet when it's time!",
  "warden.boss.crowd1": "I wonder when they will \"Go-at\" (horn) the start of the fight?",
  "warden.boss.crowd2": "Where is the music? Isn't it supposed to start?",
  "warden.boss.crowd2fail": "Even the Warden got too tired of waiting for the music to start...",
  "warden.boss.crowd3": "The Warden is so ready to act, when does the lightshow start?",
  "warden.boss.crowd3after": "IT'S DOING THE WORM! THE WORM!",
  "warden.boss.crowd4": "We need another mob on stage! (Or a player who looks like a mob)",
  "warden.boss.crowd5": "It looks like the Warden is done, where is the finale?",
  "warden.boss.final": "There should have been rewards, and flowers should come from the crowd, but you know... lol",
  "world.mine.status": "Status: ",
  "world.mine.effects": "Effects:",
  "world.mine.won": "Won",
  "world.mine.lost": "Lost"
}
```
</details>
